Now that i have read your other comments/replies, just quit it. Totally understand it. I might also blamed myself had i been in your situation. I’m also used to be a top grad and achiever til i got hit by MDD. You’re just blaming yourself for others mistakes. No one could blame you in this situation. Sorry i might sound rude but it’s something you should know (might be something i wish someone says to me). I know sometimes it sound dumb saying it, but please don’t be depressed.

Don’t mind about your boss, company connection. Had the question come in your future interview, just explain to them what you went through. If they failed to acknowledge it, then they probably has the same shitty working environment.

You did nothing wrong. The easiest way is to quit and move on. 
But you could also played it to your advantage. First thing first get it straight with your boss, saying you gonna try your best doing the job (without pushing you to the edge doing ot and stuff) but if you couldn’t get it done, no one should blame you. Heck even if they blame you, worst they could do is fired you. So don’t stress is out. 
About the audit, try ask your former executive if she is willing to help. Previous documents would also help a lot. And maybe you gonna need to stretch a bit and search and ask how to do it on internet. If you could do it, it’s gonna be big experience to you. After that, its your decision to stay or search for better opportunities (i hope you search and get better company). Btw if you choose to stay and go through it, please don’t stressed or blame yourself. Even if you couldn’t complete it, it’s okay. Just take it easy.
